fact: The health ministry launched the Vacci360 pilot on 2 April 2026 in Lac, Kanem and Hadjer Lamis provinces, adding an analysis layer to the existing DHIS2 base.
The health ministry's 2025 health statistics yearbook, in validation on 22 September 2026, rests on the national DHIS2 platform base.

Between 31 August and 2 September 2026, 24 health workers from private facilities in N'Djamena were trained and given configured tablets in a DHIS2 reporting pilot run with the Ministry of Health's information systems directorate (DSIS) and WHO.
